purpose: Strengthened research team (Ds002 advice): mine the commander's statements into timeless topics, distil records under the docspec, validated, compared and contested

seats.name: topic-extractor
seats.reason: deciding what is a timeless topic and what is chatter is judgement

seats.name: record-writer
seats.reason: distilling a topic into a record under six tests is synthesis
seats.returns: six records and one register; built a citation-resolving check

seats.name: discovery
seats.reason: fetching repo terrain to validate references is retrieval
seats.returns: 27 per-topic terrain notes, four batch reports

seats.name: validator
seats.reason: adjudicating disputed claims against official sources is lookup
seats.returns: adjudications on request; nested-subagent clause cut

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: adversary and comparer in one seat
seats.returns: about forty findings across four passes; six withdrawn in writing

shape: extractor first; discovery and validator as topics landed; writer drafted once topics were stable, sent each draft to adversary and validator, revised, delivered; the lead filed topics and put records to the commander as Ds003
outcome: Topic store filed (27 topics, 203 statements). Seven records drafted at records/notepad/research-2026-09-18/records-final/, dossier Ds003, request Rq009. Two over-broad supersessions caught and narrowed. Two commander rulings obtained in session (Or039, Or040). Pilot's own errors caught by seats: two turn-opener line numbers in a ruling, one wrong advice-file attribution, one over-broad supersession ruling. The writer's script found one wrong citation in 83 that four passes had not. Records await the commander's ruling on Rq009.
lessons: the topic store is the right intermediate: it caught a superseded claim the writer had just added and made every quote checkable with one command
a summarising fetch can establish a presence but never an absence; check every negative against raw HTML
anchor findings on quoted text, not line numbers
a wrong citation is present and a missing one is absent; only a script that resolves each citation against its line catches it
a writer that applies a disputed ruling in its weakest true form and sends the question up is what gets the commander to answer it
brief every seat with the full read scope it will need; lifting boundaries mid-run cost rounds
two seats should not share a name across teams
extend a verifier and prove it fails on a bad input before trusting its pass
